snippet.title: Brainrot Online Trailer 2
snippet.description: A fast-paced multiplayer FPS where bizarre brainrot creatures battle across chaotic arenas. Join or create your own server, fight bots or players, and dominate the battlefield with four absurd characters and three unique maps. Brainrot Online on Steam! Wishlist now.
